message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on the facts: a medical staff (Kang) used his position to accept bribes (kickbacks) from a medical device company via a person, total 68,000 RMB. He voluntarily surrendered, self-reported. So the crime is "受贿" (accepting bribes). Also possibly "行贿" is not his act. Could be "贿赂罪" but the specific term is "受贿罪". Also "职务侵占" is for misappropriation of property, not here. So only "受贿". The law: Criminal Law article 385 etc. So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.

Make sure format: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
